name: Beanstalk
install: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; export PATH="$NVM_DIR/versions/node/$(nvm version default)/bin:$PATH"; cd food-recall-app && npm ci

terminals.name: dev
terminals.command: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; export PATH="$NVM_DIR/versions/node/$(nvm version default)/bin:$PATH"; cd food-recall-app && npm run dev
terminals.description: Vite dev server for the Beanstalk food-recall-app, served at http://localhost:5173/beanstalk/ (append ?demo=1 for fictional demo data). Uses the nvm default Node (>= 22.22) to satisfy jsdom/undici engine requirements.
